quest.title: Through the Motions, to the Heart
quest.description: You get through the aristocratic conduct training, albeit with some hiccups along the way. During the training, you believe you may have discovered what shapes Eula's personality. You say goodbye to Eula and decide to act — first, you will procure a greeting gift, then you will meet with Schubert once more.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x725, Primogem x60, Mora x44000, Guide to Resistance x5, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

chapter.title: The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea

talks.objective: Head towards Springvale and look for Schubert

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (The tent seems to be pretty tattered, but there's a really fancy chair...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Could this be another aristocratic custom?)

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you again. I thought I had rid myself of you two.

choices.text: We have heard that aristocrats are most magnanimous.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Magnanimous... Yes, indeed that is true.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Very well, I am certainly not one to be narrow-minded. I'll overlook your previous misconduct for now and listen to what you have to say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Wow, this guy thinks so highly of himself!)

choices.text: Before I go further, I wish to express my will of resistance.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Ah, a kindred spirit, I see. Yes, we must resist the blundering Knights of Favonius. You are true and principled.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Impressive, my intentions were to test your humility. It seems you have become well-versed in our etiquette.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Oh, so he was testing us... Sheesh, what an ordeal!)

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Your conduct is satisfactory. I must say, such progress in such a short time is practically unfathomable.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: If I may ask, from whence did you learn such a civilized manner of speech?

choices.text: I was fortunate enough to benefit from the knowledge of a dear friend.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Ah good, very good. You are bright, and compared with the common folk of Mondstadt, you certainly have potential. If you were of aristocratic blood, your prospects would be promising indeed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way, we brought a gift! Ahem... Paimon means, we would like to present you with a small token of our goodwill.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Huh? Could this be... Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut!?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: It's evident that your sentiment is genuine. As a young person nowadays, only with no small effort could you achieve such a dish.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: It's been so long since I dug into a big tasty— ...I beg your pardon. What I mean to say is, since it's nearly mealtime, I shall partake.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Ah yes, this aroma, just as I remember it. And this exquisite sour flavor... Mmm. A delicacy that only us noblemen and women could appreciate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now even Paimon's starting to wonder what it tastes like...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: I acknowledge your genuine goodwill. Such sincerity must certainly imply that you come bearing a request.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It seems there's word that the Lawrence family has a grand scheme of sorts.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Wait, so you've come to know of this, too? It was meant to be a family secret...

choices.text: I wish to lend you a helping hand.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Well, considering your meticulous etiquette, you must be a talent of unusual fortitude. I'm willing to place my full trust in you.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Please, come with me. We happen to be in need of competent fellows like yourself.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where are we going?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: To see some friends from a distant land. They have offered their assistance in restoring the Lawrence Clan to its former glory.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So he trusts us solely based on your etiquette...

choices.text: I think we need to be careful.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Well then, let's get going, shall we? You'll understand everything in due course.

choices.text: Perhaps this is what the old aristocrats see as most important.
I would like to do what I can for the nobility.
I refined my conduct with some instruction in the classics, courtesy of a dear friend.
It is an honor to stand before you here, immersed in your supreme brilliance.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: It appears I have misjudged you. "Supreme brilliance" — the glory of the nobility that continues to this day. A true loyalist!

choices.text: Please, if I may be so bold as to say a few humble words...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: "A few humble words," eh? Yes, that sounds appropriate enough.

talks.objective: Go with Schubert to meet his "friends"

dialogues.speaker: Daler
dialogues.text: Hold it right there. Who's this?

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: If you really must know...

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: They're my guests. If you happen to offend them in even the slightest, then you will be held accountable by the Lawrence Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Daler
dialogues.text: But this matter is of utmost secrecy, we must exercise caution.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: You dare question the ways of a nobleman? I don't have time for this. Make way!

dialogues.speaker: Daler
dialogues.text: No need to sound all high and mighty like that...

dialogues.speaker: Daler
dialogues.text: Fine, you may proceed.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Huh? Why have you put on a mask all of a sudden?

choices.text: I don't wish to be seen by any strangers.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Hmm, even if they are powerful, our status is much higher than theirs in the land of Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: ...And therefore, we shouldn't allow them to admire our true faces so easily! I see, haha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good thinking, Paimon thought for sure they'd recognize us.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Let's proceed, shall we? I'll introduce you as my guest.

choices.text: It is only proper for aristocrats to wear a mask.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Don't touch me, get out of my way! I'll leave on my own!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It seems we've finally caught up with you. This place is crawling with Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. It seems your investigation went well.

choices.text: It was all worth it.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Aha! I see now. So you're the one that taught them our etiquette? And I thought you despised such pleasantries!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Furthermore, there is a rule in our family. Such traditions are never to be taught to outsiders!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ah yes, rings a bell. So what? I had no reason not to teach them.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Y—You have brought shame to our family and ruined my plans! It's all for naught now!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I know that you poured great efforts into these plans, uncle. But you were well aware that it was not the right thing to do. As a Knight of Favonius, I could not overlook your actions.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Knight of Favonius!? Let's get one thing straight. I am your uncle, and you are a member of the Lawrence Clan! You should strive to restore your family's glory!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: You still have a chance. Defeat every Knight of Favonius here, and leave with me!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Then I shall plea with the family to spare you and give you a new beginning!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: So just to be clear, you want a Knight of Favonius to attack the Knights of Favonius?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: I shall say this one last time. You are not a Knight of Favonius. You are a descendant of the Lawrence Clan!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: The blood of the Lawrence Clan flows in your veins! You must comply with the will of the family!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Since when have I ever complied with the will of the family?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Wh—Why you... you unruly maid!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If anyone should be angry, it should be me. As a member of the Lawrence Clan, you knowingly plotted against the city of Mondstadt and threatened its safety.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Had you ever stopped to consider the trouble it would bring to so many people? Had you considered how many enemies you would make trying to keep the plans under wraps?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Y—You dare lecture me!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: That's right, in the name of the family that you so dearly revere, Uncle Schubert.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I've never experienced the age of "glory" you always speak of, and I've never understood our family's incessant pursuit of it.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But I am capable of discerning right from wrong, and I deeply understand what "freedom" means to the people of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The Lawrence Clan should never and will never become what you've dreamed it to be!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Grr...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Oh, the disgrace of it all! How could such a rebellious monster emerge from our own family!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh... things are starting to get pretty hysterical here. Politeness and elegance seem to have gone out the window.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: That's enough fuss for today. You two, take him away. The Honorary Knight and I have other matters to attend to.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Given that you've already taken action, I assume you've come across some conclusive evidence?

choices.text: The Fatui are in possession of a diagram of Mondstadt's defenses.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon took a peek at their diagram. Your uncle had mapped out all of the Knight's patrol routes and marked out key information about Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: *sigh* And there was me thinking that he was just another elder of the family — and a lazy one at that. I never suspected he could stoop this low. So stubborn... Mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Let's discuss this later. Our first priority is recovering that diagram.

choices.text: The Fatui are planning something terrible.
Things progressed much faster than we anticipated.

talks.objective: Talk to the Fatuus guarding the entrance

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Please don't tell Eula a word of what I've said.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: She might think I'm being too nosy.

talks.objective: Talk to the Fatui ahead of you

dialogues.speaker: Sergei
dialogues.text: (Huh, where have I seen this person before...?)

dialogues.speaker: Sergei
dialogues.text: And who, may I ask, is this? We mustn't bring just anyone in here.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: This is our new ally that I've recently met. They are completely trustworthy, you have the word of the Lawrence Clan.

choices.text: It's a pleasure to meet you.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Our plans are strictly confidential. It's not wise to bring in an outsider at this time.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Furthermore, there's been word that an outlander who joined the Knights of Favonius has been very active in Mondstadt recently.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Don't be ridiculous. Besides, my guest is well-versed in the etiquette of the nobility. I must treat them with the proper mutual respect.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: The Knights of Favonius pay no regard to such details, they could never understand the intricacies of our etiquette.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: And what about this... thing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh...? You mean Paimon?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Enough! You dare question my word? Need I remind you who it is that has made your activity in Mondstadt possible?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Without the support of the Lawrence Clan, you would all have been driven out by the Knights of Favonius like dogs.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: You must immediately offer your sincerest apologies to my friend — you've offended their honor!

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Tsk!

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Fine. I'll take your word and make no further inquiries.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Now, to the matter at hand. Did you bring the diagram of Mondstadt's defenses, as promised?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Oh... so that's what's going on here...!)

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Yes, of course. Here it is.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Let me see... Huh. Why is it so poorly drawn? Everything's so squiggly and crooked. And what is this shape supposed to be?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Excuse me? I'll have you know that I went to great lengths to carefully draw this map by hand myself!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: That "shape" is the symbol of the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Ah, I see. Crude, but I can make do. Are you able to verify that this is all reliable information?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Of course, you needn't worry about that. Don't forget what we agreed upon, the flag of the Lawrence Clan will fly above the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: The rights to that building as well as the whole of Mondstadt belong to the Lawrence Clan.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Yes, yes, we will both profit from this agreement. There's no use haggling over the details.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: We will make good use of the intel you provided. Also, be certain not to divulge our identity. There would be diplomatic consequences, you know.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Don't worry. This matter is only between you and I... and my new friend here. No one else will know of it.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Once this is over, I shall stand atop the Favonius Headquarters and rebuke their pathetic rule over Mondstadt. Then, the city and all its people will once again be under the rightful and unwavering rule of the Lawrence Clan!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Haha, perfect! Just as it once was, and just as it should be!

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: *sigh*...

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: May I remind you once again that we mustn't act rashly. That is all... for now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Very well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Very well.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Huh, what are you doing?

choices.text: No need to keep up appearances!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! It's the Honorary Knight and their trusty companion, Paimon! We're here to crush your evil schemes into dust! Dust!!!

choices.text: ...And breathe...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: So this was all just a ploy to deceive me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's your own fault, who would put so much trust in someone based purely on their manners?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: After so much planning, this is how it ends!? We'll see about that!

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: Just as I expected. I knew I should have never trusted these foolish aristocrats.

response.speaker: Sergei
response.text: No matter... We already have the intel we need. Get them!

choices.text: I think they got the message, Paimon.
The jig is up!

dialogues.speaker: Boris
dialogues.text: Don't wander about if you don't have business being here.

talks.objective: Go deeper within and retrieve the diagram of the city's defenses
Go deeper within and retrieve the diagram of the city's defenses
Go deeper within and retrieve the diagram of the city's defenses

dialogues.speaker: Ivan
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Ivan
dialogues.text: Just because someone brought you here, don't think you can wander around.

dialogues.speaker: Observe Chair
dialogues.text: (This fancy chair really stands out in front of such an old tattered tent.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Chair
dialogues.text: (Schubert must really treasure this chair. Only a true aristocrat would bother maintaining luxury items in circumstances like this.)

talks.objective: Talk to Eula and say goodbye

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This must be it. They may very well have already made a copy of it...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But without my uncle as their puppet, there'd be no use in them attacking the city.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Fatui wouldn't have relied only on your uncle.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: True, but if their plan had hinged purely on taking Mondstadt by force, as opposed to with the help of a puppet, they could have spared themselves the trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: The Fatui are dishonest, but they wouldn't go as far as to start an open war. Their opposition wouldn't just be Mondstadt alone...

choices.text: Right, that's what I was thinking.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Anyway, I'll inform the Acting Grand Master. She'll know how to handle things from here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: By the way, why did you follow us here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, you suddenly appeared at just the right moment.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Yeah, about that...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Because you stole my targets by attacking the Fatui I'd been tracking earlier...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...I came to exact my vengeance. You tried to do my job for me, and I'm here to return the favor.

choices.text: So getting the diagram of Mondstadt's defenses was your way of exacting vengeance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Finally, after all this time, Paimon understands what you're saying!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In reality, you sensed that something might happen to us during our investigation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You were worried about us and your uncle, so you brought a team to take a look!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: My purpose was vengeance, don't twist the story.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hmph, you don't look too bright, but it turns out you have a knack for scheming...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: And mark my words, I'll remember that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what do you mean Paimon doesn't look too bright!?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You have seeded a deep enmity between us... just you wait.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Even if you were to be completely destroyed, I would never forget you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, does that make us your "arch-enemies"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bring it on!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hahaha, I like your fighting spirit. I'll take this diagram back to the Knights of Favonius and take it from here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure... well... see you around!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: That you will. And make sure not to steal my targets next time!

choices.text: Guess we're even now, right?
That would be putting the cart before the horse.

dialogues.speaker: Daler
dialogues.text: Go on in.

dialogues.speaker: Pyotr
dialogues.text: Our preparations have been thorough...

dialogues.speaker: Pyotr
dialogues.text: ...But I still can't shake this uneasy feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think his "friends" are the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Things will get sticky if the Fatui happen to recognize you. What should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: As you'll see in a moment, there are many already helping us.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: I heard that this area had already been purged once by the Knights of Favonius, but it's the only place around Mondstadt that is well concealed and spacious enough.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Although it has fallen into disrepair and does not suit the tastes of the nobility, we simply have to make do for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, s—sorry, um... can we walk any faster?

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Of course not. An aristocrat always moves with grace in his steps, moving hurriedly is unacceptable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As expected, it's the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: As expected?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... b—because we always see them around the city. Um... they must be... very powerful!

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Hmph, nothing more than foreign ruffians with power and the ability to flaunt it... But they are favorable business partners.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good thing you're with us, they don't dare to question you...

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Of course, that is the benefit of prestige. In past times, it would be a dire offense to speak to a nobleman in such a manner.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: We could determine a person's fate with the blink of an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Schubert
dialogues.text: Hmph, and such glory will return to me again before long.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're running off in different directions!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers that this place is a dead end. Let's take care of the Fatui first and then deal with Schubert later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The door is open, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There it is! That's where they've put the diagram!

dialogues.speaker: Sergei
dialogues.text: So you've tracked us here, huh? I guess there's no other option but to fight.
